description: Deletes WebinarIgnition's own diagnostic log files. Side effect: the logs are gone and cannot be restored; the campaign, its registrants and its emails are NOT touched. Needs `session_id` and a clear yes (`confirm` true); with `webinar_id` only that campaign's logs go, without it the logs of ALL campaigns on the install are cleared, so pass the id whenever the host named a webinar and say which of the two it is. Use it when the host wants a clean slate for diagnostics, for example before reproducing a problem, then read the state with wi_get_connector_status.

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said which logs may be cleared.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

webinar_id.description: Clear only this campaign's logs. Leave it out to clear the logs of every campaign on the site.

name: wi_delete_webinar_logs
title: Delete the WebinarIgnition log files
